RunStarted(run)
TextMessageStart(run, msg)
TextMessageContent(run, msg, "I will check the workspace. ")
TextMessageEnd(run, msg)
ToolCallStart(run, call-1, list_files)
ToolCallArgs(run, call-1, "{\"directory\":\".\"}")
ToolCallEnd(run, call-1)
ToolCallResult(run, call-1, "a.txt\nb.txt", false)
TextMessageStart(run, msg)
TextMessageContent(run, msg, "The workspace has a.txt and b.txt.")
TextMessageEnd(run, msg)
RunFinished(run, stop)
